header.purpose: when a service coordinator hands over a customer's fault report, summarise it in a first pass, route the checked summary on by a fixed check, then draft a proposed fix note in a second pass for the coordinator to decide and send
metrics: share of summaries passed on by the check
share of drafts the coordinator sends with light edits

trigger.step_up_evidence: ten runs with no missed input

drafting_boundary.entry_rung: drafts the fix note; the coordinator decides and sends every one
drafting_boundary.step_up_evidence: no edits needed on most drafts

handoff_writes.next_rung: hand-off file plus a queue note

person_checkpoint.step_up_evidence: flag rate agreed with the owner

parts.input: the coordinator's hand-over of one fault report
parts.output: the fault report passed to the first pass
parts.end_point: the report dispatched to the summariser

routing.basis: a fixed trigger: the hand-over itself starts the flow, so no route is inferred

parts.input: one fault report with the product setup it names
parts.output: a checked summary, routed to the second pass or back to the coordinator
parts.end_point: the check passes the summary to the drafter, or returns it to the coordinator

routing.basis: the summary is written by the model but routed only by a fixed check; no model reads another model's output directly

parts.input: the checked summary and the fix options for the product
parts.output: a draft fix note, or an escalation when the evidence does not support one
parts.end_point: one case with the summary and the draft or the escalation, handed to the coordinator; nothing is sent

routing.basis: the fix note is written text, behind a fixed gate

rejected_alternatives.alternative: a model router that picks the next part before any pass starts
rejected_alternatives.why: the start is a fixed event and the only chain is summary to draft through a fixed check, so nothing needs inferring

rejected_alternatives.alternative: one part that summarises and drafts in a single pass
rejected_alternatives.why: the summary is checked on its own before any draft is written
